name: AdGuard Chinese filter
note: Regles non exprimables en Content Blocker WebKit mais exploitables par un moteur a injection (Safari Web Extension). Non chargeables telles quelles par Safari.

scriptlets.name: inject-css-in-shadow-dom
args: .ad-container, .vd-ad, cs-native-ad-card-no-hover, display-ads, .display-ad-container, .display-ads-container, .views-right-rail-top-display, #entry-point-hp-wc-banner, .me-stripe-title-subtitle, #displayAdCard, a[href*=".booking.com/"], a[href^="https://amzn.to/"] { display: none !important; }

scriptlets.name: json-prune-fetch-response
args: prerolls midrolls postrolls comm_ad house_ad pause_ad block_ad end_ad exit_ad pin_ad content_pool vertical_ad elements
